no_adcom_quote.quote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No FDA advisory committee meeting was convened for XTANDI (enzalutamide, NDA203415). The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review all state that the application was not referred to an advisory committee because there were no controversial issues and the benefit-risk profile was clearly favorable. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
